name: Cayman Islands

findings.controller: Alcatel Submarine Networks (lead technology and marine partner)
findings.summary: Liberty Networks began MAYA-1.2, reconfiguring the MAYA-1 cable and keeping its Grand Cayman landing, doubling Cayman capacity to 4 Tbps per direction; Alcatel Submarine Networks is lead technology and marine partner, completion due 2026.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole third because the named equipment/marine vendor is ASN (France); the SLTE vendor is not named, so terminal-equipment control is unconfirmed. Tier 4 because reconfiguration work was underway with completion due H1 2026; completion not confirmed, so still_current null. The $250m figure is Liberty's wider regional programme, not this project, so values null. Compass article relays the operator, so independence is partial.

findings.local_actor: Cayman Islands Government, Ministry of Planning, Lands, Agriculture, Housing & Infrastructure (PLAHI)
findings.summary: PLAHI issued a Notice of Opportunity seeking an international wholesale operator to build and run a new submarine cable to Grand Cayman, optionally linking Cayman Brac, backed by a one-time government subsidy; a Telconet-led consortium was among declared bidders.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null because no operator or equipment vendor had been selected in the sources read; the Telconet consortium (Ecuador-based) would be third if chosen. Coded tier 2 as a procurement opened after a 2024 business case, not an award. Earlier steps: business case published March 2024 (Baxtel, opened) and a September 2025 ministry update.

findings.local_actor: Department of Public Safety Communications (National CCTV Development Programme)
findings.summary: The Department of Public Safety Communications runs a national CCTV network of about 400 cameras, with 25-50 more planned for 2025; 21 cameras costing $190,000 went live on Cayman Brac in November 2025. No camera or software vendor is named.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null because the camera/VMS vendor is not named and the equipment vendor sets the pole; the operator is domestic. No AI analytics reported. The $190,000 is the Brac expansion only, currency assumed CI$ or US$ unstated, so values null. Both sources from one outlet, no S1/S2.
